instruction: Compare iPad Pro 12.9-inch with iPad Pro 11-inch and iPad Air

metadata.explanation: Task requires comparing 3 iPad models on Apple's website. Evaluator checks that the active tab URL contains the modelList parameter with the 3 specified iPad models (order-independent). Similar complexity to original task, just different product category.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts modelList parameter from URL query params using urlparse and parse_qs
Metric logic correctly compares extracted list with expected values using order-independent comparison (ignore_list_order: true)
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies all 3 required iPad models are present in the comparison
Data flow is correct: getter extracts URL state -> metric compares list values with proper handling of unordered lists
Practically feasible: active tab URL can be extracted via accessibility tree, URL parameters are accessible
Expected values semantically match instruction requirements (3 specific iPad model identifiers)
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor consideration: Expected model identifiers (ipad-pro-12-9, ipad-pro-11, ipad-air) assume specific Apple URL slug format - validation during testing recommended to confirm exact URL structure
Enhancement opportunity: Could add validation that comparison page is actually displayed (not just URL check), though URL parameter verification is typically sufficient for web navigation tasks
